import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a categorical plot to show the distribution of transaction amounts by hour and fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', data=df, palette='coolwarm')

# Set labels and title
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Hour and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Fraud', loc='upper right', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
